closed_findings: Every fixed/glob/extra directory uses one walk that rejects root and descendant .git markers, symlink roots/ancestors/descendants, and nonregular files. Explicit evidence subdirectories inside the project remain allowed; their Git root is not recursively copied.
The before-v8 phase rejects v7/v8/v9/v10 filename and raw-directory components, including direct extra-path additions.

All collected candidates undergo bounded regular-file reads, weight name and GGUF magic checks, download-request naming/structure checks, and signed/bearer URL text checks before ZIP creation. A second content/identity check rejects changed candidates.
limits: This fixes the candidate-selection/preflight guard boundary; it does not approve an upload.
Validation used 36 tiny synthetic checks and AST ordering only, as enumerated in the fixture receipt; no real archive was built or replayed.
Unknown opaque binary content and nested archives/bundles retain separate content review; the text classifier is not proof that all arbitrary bytes are nonsensitive.
Filesystem identity checks assume a cooperative task workspace; they are not a general hostile-host or privileged adversary proof.
